lat_level.name: local level
lat_level.about: The true average level of the 32 steps this patch covers, as the simulator knows it.

lat_slope.name: local slope
lat_slope.about: How fast the true signal is rising or falling across this patch.

lat_curv.name: local curvature
lat_curv.about: How much the true signal bends within this patch.

lat_noise_sd.name: noise size
lat_noise_sd.about: How big the noise is in this patch.

lat_inn_sd.name: size of the fresh shocks
lat_inn_sd.about: How large the new random kick at each step is.

lat_pred1.name: one-step predictability
lat_pred1.about: How well the referee can guess the next step: the share the true equations explain.

lat_phase_sin.name: season phase (sine)
lat_phase_sin.about: Where in its cycle the season is, as the sine of the angle.

lat_phase_cos.name: season phase (cosine)
lat_phase_cos.about: Where in its cycle the season is, as the cosine of the angle.

lat_regime.name: which regime
lat_regime.about: Which of the rule sets the series is currently running on.

lat_regime_frac.name: share of patch after a switch
lat_regime_frac.about: What part of the patch comes after a regime switch.

lat_since_switch.name: time since a switch
lat_since_switch.about: Steps since the rules last changed.

lat_log2_period.name: season length
lat_log2_period.about: Length of the repeating season in force (on a log scale).

lat_outlier.name: outlier present
lat_outlier.about: Whether the patch contains a wild jump.

lat_outlier_mag.name: outlier size
lat_outlier_mag.about: How big the wild jump is.

prev_level.name: previous patch: level
prev_level.about: The local level of the patch before this one.

prev_slope.name: previous patch: slope
prev_slope.about: The local slope of the patch before this one.

prev_noise_sd.name: previous patch: noise
prev_noise_sd.about: The noise size of the patch before this one.

prev_phase_sin.name: previous patch: season phase (sine)
prev_phase_sin.about: Season phase of the patch before this one.

prev_phase_cos.name: previous patch: season phase (cosine)
prev_phase_cos.about: Season phase of the patch before this one.

prev_regime.name: previous patch: regime
prev_regime.about: Which regime the patch before this one was in.

m_level_ctx.name: level vs the history
m_level_ctx.about: The patch's average, compared with the whole history.

m_slope.name: measured slope
m_slope.about: A straight-line fit to the patch values.

m_curv.name: measured curvature
m_curv.about: A parabola fit to the patch values.

m_logsd.name: spread of the patch
m_logsd.about: How spread out the patch's values are (log scale).

m_resid_sd.name: wiggle left after a smooth fit
m_resid_sd.about: Size of what remains once a smooth curve is taken out of the patch.

m_jump.name: biggest jump
m_jump.about: The largest one-step jump, compared with the usual step.

m_peak_pos.name: where the peak sits
m_peak_pos.about: Where in the patch the highest value falls.

m_trough_pos.name: where the trough sits
m_trough_pos.about: Where in the patch the lowest value falls.

m_zero_cross.name: crossings of its own mean
m_zero_cross.about: How often the patch crosses its own average.

m_skew.name: lopsidedness
m_skew.about: Whether the patch has a longer tail up or down.

m_kurt.name: tailedness
m_kurt.about: Whether the patch has extreme values beyond a bell curve.

m_monotone.name: one-directional
m_monotone.about: Whether the patch mostly goes one way.

m_dlevel_prev.name: level change from previous patch
m_dlevel_prev.about: How much the average moved since the last patch.

m_dsd_prev.name: spread change from previous patch
m_dsd_prev.about: How much the spread changed since the last patch.

m_range.name: range
m_range.about: Highest minus lowest value in the patch.

m_acf1.name: step-to-step memory
m_acf1.about: How much each step resembles the one before it.

m_max_z.name: most extreme value
m_max_z.about: How far the most extreme value is from the patch's centre.

m_roughness.name: roughness
m_roughness.about: How jagged the step-to-step changes are.

x_post_cp.name: after a measured change point
x_post_cp.about: Whether the patch lies after the change point found from the values.

x_since_cp.name: steps since measured change point
x_since_cp.about: Steps since the change point found from the values.

x_phase_sin.name: measured season phase (sine)
x_phase_sin.about: Season phase estimated from the values.

x_phase_cos.name: measured season phase (cosine)
x_phase_cos.about: Season phase estimated from the values.

x_log2_period.name: measured season length
x_log2_period.about: Season length estimated from the history (log scale).

x_season_strength.name: measured season strength
x_season_strength.about: How strongly the history repeats at its best period.

x_noise_level.name: measured noise level
x_noise_level.about: What is left of the history after trend and season are removed.

x_ar1.name: measured memory
x_ar1.about: Step-to-step correlation of the leftover noise.

x_hurst.name: measured long memory
x_hurst.about: How fast the history's wandering grows with the window (Hurst exponent).

x_tail.name: measured tail weight
x_tail.about: How heavy the tails of the history's steps are.

x_cp_strength.name: measured change-point strength
x_cp_strength.about: How large the biggest shift in the history is.

s_log2_period.name: season length
s_log2_period.about: The season length the generator was told to use (log scale).

s_has_season.name: has a season
s_has_season.about: Whether the series has a repeating season at all.

s_season_amp.name: season strength
s_season_amp.about: How large the season is compared with the rest.

s_noise_level.name: noise level
s_noise_level.about: How noisy the whole series is.

s_ar_rho.name: noise memory
s_ar_rho.about: How strongly each noise value carries over to the next.

s_lyap.name: chaos speed
s_lyap.about: How quickly tiny differences grow (Lyapunov exponent per step); zero for non-chaotic series.

s_alpha.name: tail heaviness
s_alpha.about: Tail index of the wild-jump generator.

s_eta.name: burst feeding
s_eta.about: How strongly one burst sets off the next (Hawkes branching).

s_msm_k.name: cascade depth
s_msm_k.about: Number of levels in the multifractal cascade.

s_jump_mag.name: jump size
s_jump_mag.about: How big the regime jump is.

s_markov_p.name: switching chance
s_markov_p.about: Chance per step of switching regime.

s_coupling.name: coupling strength
s_coupling.about: How strongly a driver or a partner series pushes this one.

s_lag.name: driver lag
s_lag.about: How many steps ago the driver acted.

pos_logj.name: how far back
pos_logj.about: Position of this patch in the history (log scale).

pos_from_end.name: distance from the end
pos_from_end.about: How many patches before the end of the history this one sits.

tok_fc.name: forecast token
tok_fc.about: Whether the token is a forecast slot rather than a history patch.

tok_fc_step.name: which forecast slot
tok_fc_step.about: Which of the forecast patches the token stands for.

tok_cov_row.name: helper-series row
tok_cov_row.about: Whether the token belongs to a helper series.

fam_in_prior.name: family: home turf
fam_in_prior.about: Series from the trend + season + noise family.

fam_coupled.name: family: coupled series
fam_coupled.about: Series with a driver or partner.

gen_lagged_driver.name: generator: lagged driver
gen_lagged_driver.about: A driver acts after a lag.

gen_feedback_linear.name: generator: linear feedback
gen_feedback_linear.about: A series and a partner feeding each other.

dead.name: never fires
dead.about: Fewer than 30 tokens where this pole is above zero, so nothing could be scored.

groups.lat_: what the simulator knows about the patch
groups.prev_: what the simulator knows about the previous patch
groups.m_: read straight from the patch values
groups.s_: a property of the whole series

note: Plain-words names for the variable library of results/neurons (otp/neurons/variables.py); text only.
